slides.title: Overnight in Ethiopia: attacks in Sodo
slides.body: At least 11 farmers killed in two weeks, residents say

slides.title: Farmers killed on Sept. 29
slides.body: in Suten kebele, according to residents and family members quoted by Borkena.

slides.title: Killed on Oct. 10
slides.body: near Gefersa Giorgis and Joro, after locals tried to free eight detained civilians, witnesses said.

slides.title: Families leaving their farms
slides.body: Residents describe kidnapping for ransom, sexual violence and livestock theft. Families have fled to Bui, Tiya and Butajira.

slides.title: Who is blamed
slides.body: A zonal official blamed the OLF-Shene armed group. No response from the group was reported. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate every killing.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
